The Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) announces a partnership with DP World, the first strategic partner of SHIFFT, a recently launched self-driving logistics joint venture established with global autonomous vehicle technology company Oxa under the Dubai Research, Development and Innovation Programme. The partnership aims to accelerate the development and deployment of autonomous logistics solutions across ports, terminals, industrial zones and DP World facilities, starting at Jebel Ali Port, with potential expansion to DP World’s network of over 60 ports and terminals worldwide.
